5. Longer parametric chains are better. If false, stacking two 3x3 convs on a series path hurts through optimization difficulty.

7. Effects are dataset-independent. If false, low-resolution ImageNet16-120 would react differently to pooling, so I favor mechanisms that should hold on all three.
8. Removing an edge costs proportionally to its op quality. If false, removing the only bypass is disproportionately harmful when the other paths are deep conv-only paths.
